== Biography ==
Robert was born in 1795.  He passed away in 1877.

Glasgow family history, 1707-1968/ [Norman "Gibb" Brown]

Robert Glasgow was born in Rothsay, Scotland in 1797 and traveled with his brothers to New Zealand in 1842. Robert married Mary Lamb and they settled in Turakina, New Zealand where they were the parents of seven children (all of whom had been born in Britain). One of their children was Adam Glasgow (1830-1880) who married Mary Stewart, daughter of Duncan Stewart. They were the parents of seven children and were one of the more prominent families of Turakina. Descendants live in New Zealand.

https://www.familysearch.org/en/search/catalog/651052

Robert was born in 1795. He was the son of [[Glasgow-1221|John Glasgow]] and [[Hunter-30137|Isabella Hunter]]. He passed away in 1877.
